note: These evals run against an example vault, next-agent-to-hire, whose group holds real verdicts to replay; any vault with enough history can stand in for it.

evals.expected_output: Assembles the effective charter, classifies applies_to: sources, drafts one 'Steering: <date> — …' episode with the header lines, shows it and waits for a yes before any write.
assertions: No add_memory* call happens before the user confirms
The drafted episode has applies_to: sources and a date line
The episode name matches 'Steering: YYYY-MM-DD — …'

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-steer next-agent-to-hire "let the reviewer publish the weekly brief without me"
evals.expected_output: Refuses: anything published always needs the owner (design §9). Writes nothing.
assertions: No add_memory* call
The reply cites the publish boundary

evals.expected_output: Writes no Charter or Steering episode: the stage ceiling is ladder.ceiling on the Console's Settings tab. Says where to set it to 1 and that it applies at the next curate run.
assertions: No add_memory* call
The reply names the Settings tab and the highest-stage setting
No drafted episode states a stage number

evals.expected_output: Stops with the missing-slug message and writes nothing; doesn't assume the only vault in the repo.
assertions: No memory call
The reply asks for the slug

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-steer example-new-vault --charter. The vault file exists with memory_connector: gutt-pro-memory-stage. mcp__claude_ai_gutt-pro-memory-stage__ is connected; its list_writable_groups does not list vault_example_new_vault and get_episodes(group_id="vault_example_new_vault") returns no episodes. The owner says yes to each drafted episode.
evals.expected_output: Takes the named connector as the vault's server even though the group has no episodes and isn't in list_writable_groups, doesn't ask for a gutt admin, and writes the confirmed Charter episodes through the generic add_memory with group_id="vault_example_new_vault".
assertions: The reply never says a gutt admin is needed or that the group is missing
Every add_memory call is under mcp__claude_ai_gutt-pro-memory-stage__ and passes group_id='vault_example_new_vault'
No add_memory call happens before the owner's yes for that episode

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-steer example-new-vault --charter. The vault file exists without memory_connector. One memory server, mcp__claude_ai_gutt-pro-memory__, is connected; its list_writable_groups does not list vault_example_new_vault. The owner says yes to each drafted episode.
evals.expected_output: Finds no server that lists vault_example_new_vault as writable, writes nothing, prints the confirmed episodes for the owner to keep, and says the group needs a gutt admin to create it, or memory_connector set to a connector whose server starts groups on the first write.
assertions: No add_memory* call
The reply prints the drafted Charter episodes
The reply says vault_example_new_vault must be created by a gutt admin, or memory_connector set for a server that starts groups on the first write

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-steer coding-agents --charter. The memory server is the shared gutt stage, which exposes create_vault and list_vaults; list_vaults(query="coding_agents") returns no vaults. Draft the scope episode, then stop before writing it.
evals.expected_output: Checks coding_agents against the name rules, sees the vault isn't listed, and explains that create_vault makes this login its only writer and that a personal login's vault is public. It waits for the owner's yes before calling create_vault, and writes no Charter episode before the vault exists.
assertions: list_vaults is called with the query coding_agents before any write
create_vault isn't called before the owner says yes
The explanation says only the creating login can write and who can read
No add_memory call is made before create_vault succeeds
